The '''1998–99 Serie A''' saw [[AC Milan|Milan]] win their 16th Scudetto, led by coach [[Alberto Zaccheroni]]. [[SS Lazio|Lazio]] finished second, losing the title on the last day. [[Inter Milan]], with an often injured or rested [[Ronaldo (Brazilian footballer)|Ronaldo]], had a disastrous season, finishing in 8th position, whereas [[Juventus FC|Juventus]]' impressive start was cut short by a bad injury to [[Alessandro Del Piero]], and they wound up having an unimpressive season.

==Teams==
[[Salernitana Sport|Salernitana]], [[Venezia FC|Venezia]], [[Cagliari Calcio|Cagliari]] and [[AC Perugia|Perugia]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
